id.description: Unique section anchor and generated HTML ID.

file.description: Markdown file path relative to the repository root. Omit for a grouping header.

nav.description: Show a top navigation link. Defaults to true for entries with a file, false for groups.

target.description: Optional ID of a div inside main in src/template.html. Otherwise render inside the parent section.

children.description: Nested sections; each level adds one heading level. Starts at h2, maximum h6.
